svg.title: One generation of an evolve run
svg.desc: 1, Measure first: The current Champion runs against a fixed baseline, so every generation starts from fresh evidence. 2, Propose: The Forge makes exactly one Mutation of the Champion and writes down why. 3, Test: Child versus Champion in the Arena, plus checks that nothing basic broke. 4, Decide: The child takes the title only if the evidence clears the World's bar. Either way it stays on record. Each generation costs two paired evaluations; the run stops at its budget or generation limit.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Repeat until the generation limit or the budget runs out. Freeze stops it at any time.
